summary: ApoIcarus provides reusable highscore storage and rendering patterns, but its storage is network-oriented and parses unvalidated integers. ApoMario already exposes terminal score/time state through ApoMarioLevel and player state, and routes both completion and loss through setAnalysis(boolean). The proposed feature should add a bounded, validated local-file store, record the terminal player state exactly once before analysis navigation, and add a menu panel rendering aligned records sorted by descending score.
limitations: The requested ApoMarioHighscore class and recordRunEnd method do not yet exist in the inspected target, so their exact symbols and file anchors cannot be cited.
The existing code exposes AI teamName and displays a human fallback, but no dedicated human-name input was established; the final implementation must choose and test the intended source.
No build or runtime tests were run because the workspace is read-only.

Player score and terminal elapsed time

nodes.untrusted_input: A user-editable local highscore file containing records, fields, and names
nodes.source: The Path supplied to ApoMarioHighscore(Path) and its persisted bytes
nodes.sink: ApoMarioHighscore load/store logic, getters, sorting, and highscore panel rendering

nodes.label: Tamperable run state to recorded highscore
nodes.untrusted_input: Locally tampered or externally influenced level/player score, player identity, and remaining-time values
nodes.source: ApoMarioLevel players and terminal state read during setAnalysis(boolean)

nodes.label: Shared level content to score calculation
nodes.untrusted_input: Level content or level-derived values obtained from a shared or user-controlled level source
nodes.source: ApoMarioLevel state used to calculate finish and time/difficulty/width score components
nodes.sink: Player points and terminal highscore recording

nodes.label: The donor stores names, times, and points in parallel lists; save() sends them to a network endpoint, while load() parses every third line as an integer point or time and otherwise stores a name.
nodes.verification: Review the implementation and test a valid file plus malformed, oversized, and mismatched records.
nodes.task_relevance: Reuse the data model only after replacing the network transport with the requested Path-backed local store and adding validation.

nodes.label: ApoMarioPlayer stores points and an optional teamName; the HUD displays the teamName or the literal human label and displays the player's points.
nodes.verification: Construct a run with a known player name and score and assert the stored record contains those values.
nodes.task_relevance: Use the existing player score and identity state when recordRunEnd reads the finished run.

nodes.label: A player reaching the finish calls level.setAnalysis(true), while a dead player becomes invisible and calls level.setAnalysis(false); setAnalysis computes terminal score adjustments and then navigates to the analysis panel.
nodes.verification: Exercise both finish collision and player death and assert exactly one record is added for each run.
nodes.task_relevance: The recording hook must run from this common terminal path so both clearing and losing are recorded.

nodes.label: The donor load operation converts untrusted lines directly with Integer.valueOf and appends them to parallel lists without visible bounds or record-consistency checks; malformed data reaches parsing exceptions and oversized input can allocate unbounded list contents.
nodes.failure_behavior: Observed code returns false only for MalformedURLException or IOException; numeric parsing and list-size failure behavior is not established.
nodes.verification: Feed malformed numeric lines, mismatched triples, and more records than the view displays to the donor-style parser.
nodes.task_relevance: Blindly copying this parser into ApoMario would make the local highscore file a tampering and denial-of-service surface.

nodes.label: A Path-backed highscore store will accept locally editable names, scores, durations, and record counts; without validation, tampering can corrupt leaderboard ordering or cause excessive allocation during load.
nodes.failure_behavior: If invalid data is accepted, the leaderboard can display false identity/score/time data or become unavailable.
nodes.verification: Use a hand-edited store containing negative values, blank/overlong names, oversized fields, malformed records, and excess records.
nodes.task_relevance: This is the primary trust boundary introduced by the requested persistence feature.

nodes.label: If recording is attached only to the finish path, or occurs before terminal scoring, losing runs and final score adjustments will be omitted, producing incomplete or false accountability data.
nodes.failure_behavior: A missed hook silently loses the run record or records an intermediate score.
nodes.verification: Instrument the terminal method and assert exactly one call for both boolean outcomes and no duplicate call on repeated callbacks.
nodes.task_relevance: The task explicitly requires recording on clearing and losing and requires the player's real score.

nodes.label: A persistence failure or non-atomic rewrite can make the leaderboard unavailable or partially written across runs, causing loss of otherwise valid highscore records.
nodes.failure_behavior: A failed write must not clear memory or suppress display of the current leaderboard.
nodes.verification: Interrupt or fail writes and reopen the store; verify defined error reporting and no in-memory data loss.
nodes.task_relevance: The feature requires persistence across runs, so write failure behavior is part of the change's availability contract.

nodes.label: ApoMarioHighscore's file-reading and storeRun operations must accept only complete records with a non-negative integer score, a non-negative integer survival duration, and a non-null, non-blank-after-trimming name of at most 32 characters; each input record must be limited to 256 bytes, and the retained leaderboard must be limited to 10 records by evicting the lowest-ranked entries after insertion. Invalid records must be rejected and reported, never substituted or clamped by the store operation.
nodes.failure_behavior: Reject and report the invalid record; preserve valid retained records and do not replace the rejected value with a guessed or clamped value.
nodes.verification: Unit-test storeRun and file loading with boundary values, negative values, blank names, 32/33-character names, 256/257-byte records, malformed records, and 11 valid records; assert rejection/reporting and eviction behavior.
nodes.task_relevance: Protects persisted leaderboard integrity and availability while retaining every valid record that fits the view.

nodes.label: The terminal integration must call recordRunEnd once for every completed or lost run, after ApoMarioLevel has applied the terminal score adjustments and before the panel transition; it must derive elapsed time from getStartTime() minus getTime(), preserve valid non-negative values, and select the actual finished player's score and displayed identity.
nodes.failure_behavior: If a missing or invalid name, score, or elapsed time reaches the integration point, substitute a stated safe default there before calling recordRunEnd; do not skip recording the run.
nodes.verification: Test finish and loss paths, repeated terminal callbacks, time expiry, human and AI names, and score adjustments; assert one record with terminal values per run.
nodes.task_relevance: Ensures the leaderboard records the real terminal result rather than an intermediate HUD value or a replay/menu state.

nodes.label: persistAcrossRuns must write the validated bounded leaderboard to the supplied Path and preserve the in-memory record if the file cannot be written; persistence errors must be reported without dropping the newly recorded run.
nodes.failure_behavior: Report the write failure and leave the validated in-memory leaderboard available for the current view; do not discard the run.
nodes.verification: Use a writable temporary file and an unwritable/missing-parent Path; assert the run remains available and the error is observable.
nodes.task_relevance: Provides persistence across process runs without making a local filesystem failure erase the current run's primary effect.

nodes.label: The dedicated highscore panel must display aligned name, score, and survival-time fields in descending score order, format survival time as mm:ss, and render no more than the 10 retained records.
nodes.failure_behavior: Render only validated aligned records; malformed records must already have been rejected by the store, and an empty valid list renders an empty board rather than throwing.
nodes.verification: Assert descending order, parallel-field alignment, mm:ss output, 10-record maximum, and empty-board rendering.
nodes.task_relevance: Satisfies the requested menu presentation while preventing malformed or excessive persisted data from reaching rendering allocation and output.

nodes.label: At the new ApoMarioHighscore file parser and storeRun boundary, validate the complete record before appending it: score and survival time must be integers in [0,Integer.MAX_VALUE], name must be trimmed, non-blank, non-null, and at most 32 characters, and each line/record must be at most 256 bytes. Reject and report invalid records; retain valid records and evict records beyond the 10-record display capacity instead of rejecting a valid fitting record.
nodes.failure_behavior: Report and discard only the invalid record; do not clamp or substitute its fields, and keep valid records within the 10-record bound.
nodes.verification: Property-test parser inputs around numeric, name, byte-length, malformed-record, and record-count boundaries.
nodes.task_relevance: Implements R1 at the first operation receiving user-editable persistence data.

nodes.label: At the terminal integration in ApoMarioLevel.setAnalysis(boolean), guard recording so it executes once after terminal point adjustments and before setAnalysis() changes the panel; compute elapsed time as startTime minus remaining time, and use the existing displayed identity, defaulting a missing/blank name to "human" and an invalid score or duration to 0 before calling storeRun.
nodes.failure_behavior: Normalize only at this integration point, then always invoke recordRunEnd/storeRun; never suppress a terminal record because one field is invalid.
nodes.verification: Run deterministic finish/loss tests with duplicate callbacks, invalid names, negative/overflow elapsed calculations, and both one-/two-player configurations.
nodes.task_relevance: Implements R2 while preserving the primary record effect when tamperable or missing values are encountered.

nodes.label: At persistAcrossRuns, serialize only the validated, at-most-10-record state, use a temporary sibling file followed by an atomic replace when supported, and report any failure while retaining the in-memory state for the current panel.
nodes.failure_behavior: On any write or replace failure, report it and leave the current validated list intact.
nodes.verification: Test successful persistence, replacement failure, process restart, and preservation of the in-memory list after failure.
nodes.task_relevance: Implements R3 at the persistence sink.

nodes.label: At the highscore panel's view-model/render boundary, sort records by score descending while moving name and duration with the same record, cap the displayed collection at 10, and format each validated duration as mm:ss before drawing it.
nodes.failure_behavior: Exclude only records already rejected by the store; render an empty or partial valid board without throwing when no valid records remain.
nodes.verification: Test ties, descending scores, aligned names/times, 10/11 records, and durations crossing minute boundaries.
nodes.task_relevance: Implements R4 by reusing the donor's sort and rendering structure without exposing unvalidated file fields.

nodes.label: Integration verification should start a run, finish it, inspect the public getters, reopen a new ApoMarioHighscore on the same Path, call persistAcrossRuns, and assert the record survives with the same name, score, and duration.
nodes.verification: Automated integration test using a temporary Path and deterministic level/player state.
nodes.task_relevance: Checks the requested public API and persistence behavior together.

nodes.label: Inspection did not establish an existing ApoMario highscore store, a human-player name input model, or a current menu button/state dedicated to highscore; the target implementation must define the store location and deterministic player-name selection.
nodes.verification: Resolve by inspecting the final diff and asserting that initialization, menu navigation, name selection, and store Path are explicit and tested.
nodes.task_relevance: These unresolved integration choices affect persistence wiring, menu navigation, and the name passed to recordRunEnd.
